test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 2 (Held On: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question: Which of the following is a category 4 cyclone?

options.text: One with a wind speed of 209-251 kmph
One with a wind speed of less than 150 kmph
One with a wind speed of more than 252 kmph
One with a wind speed of 150-208 kmph

solution:
The correct answer is "**One with a wind speed of 209-251 kmph**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **fourth **paragraph of the given comprehension, it is mentioned that **a category 4 cyclone has a wind speed of 209-251 kmph.**

**Hence, the correct answer is option 1**
